SAY: I accept your grocery and Splitwise terms, and I propose a weekly rotating chore chart, 24-hour notice for guests, and quiet morning cooking before 7am to fit your sleep.

PFR:[cln:weekly rotating chore chart with a shared-space checklist (kitchen, bathroom, floors), and I'll take the kitchen wipe-down on my cooking days|if you take a bathroom slot each rotation]
FLX:[gwk:24-hour notice for any guests, within your 4-person cap and 9pm end|if you text me the day before, I'm fine]
FLX:[nzl:I'll keep early-morning kitchen noise low before 7am, using no loud appliances|if you keep shared-space noise down after 9:30pm]
